entries.positive_observation: Swept dark-brown hair and receding hairline, two distinct dark brows, smooth face without facial hair, sober single mouth and slight viewer-left orientation are preserved. The leather flight jacket, broad shearling collar, gray-green ribbed neck layer and tan center-chest layer remain visible. A rounded chin meets the fitted collar through a short broad transition without a long stalk, pinching, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. Full white/cyan comparisons show no white working-matte halo, interior holes, see-through clothing or lost subject regions. The source's transparent exterior is represented directly by the returned native alpha rather than by an opaque working background.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the returned native RGBA with actual extrema0..254 and no visible interior holes or matte halo. Internal near-opacity values252..254 are not by themselves a rejection under visible-alpha-v1. Do not run source-alpha replacement on this approved output; the earlier opaque-matte derivative remains a separate rejected experiment.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact small tan and gray center-chest layer shapes cannot be identified further at 42x46; no extra accessory or microscopic match is claimed. Those limits do not conceal the visible clothing groups or collar fit.
entries.canonical_write_boundary: Art approval is recorded, but the separate built-in production owner is active under v7. No concurrent generated.json write was attempted. The original native PNG was copied byte-for-byte to generated_fullsize and hash-verified.
